let yes = true
let no = false

write_line("the literals are true and false")

fi
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

let yes = true
let no = false

write_line("the literals are true and false")
write_line("printing them gives {yes} and {no}")

if yes then
    write_line("a condition takes a bool and nothing else")
fi

let unknown: bool? = null

if unknown ?? false then
    write_line("an absent bool counted as true")
else
    write_line("an optional bool needs a fallback to be a condition")
fi
output:
the literals are true and false
printing them gives True and False
a condition takes a bool and nothing else
an optional bool needs a fallback to be a condition
